notes.title: Happy Merry Solstice Christmas Holidays!
notes.content:
During the darkest night on the Northern hemisphere, eternal light shines on in space.

Only in the shadows of celestial objects and further away from the sun, night reins supreme.

- Added some levels
- Added 1 new achievement
- Some other stuff

notes.title: Autograb patch
notes.content:
-Cat will now grab red/rubber surfaces automatically and hold onto them.

-Fixed dark cat properly I hope.

-Added 3 flywheel levels

Please report any bugs if you find them :)

notes.title: Initial level progression achievements
notes.content:
Achievements should be achieved if you just start the game and have completed more than 9 levels before.
3 Achievements:
10 levels cleared
25 levels cleared
50 levels

notes.title: Fixed negative force multiplier for spinning object cat interaction
notes.content:
Removed cases where the force multiplier for the cat is negative when an object is spinning quickly, causing the cat to drag itself towards the object instead of away from it.
Should make level 55 easier.
